label: pass
title: Add orders with all-or-nothing stock checks
body:
We need real orders, not just quotes.

- `POST /orders` with body `{ items: [{ id, quantity }], discountCode? }`:
  - validate input exactly like a quote should (items required and non-empty, known book ids, positive integer quantities, valid discount code) → `400 { error }` otherwise;
  - check stock for **all** items first; if any item has insufficient stock → `409 { error, item: <bookId> }` and **no stock changes at all**;
  - otherwise decrement stock for every item and create an order `{ id, items, totalCents, createdAt }` → `201` with the order. `totalCents` is computed like the cart total (discount then tax). Ids are sequential per app instance: `ord_1`, `ord_2`, …; `createdAt` is an ISO timestamp.
- `GET /orders/:id` → the order, or `404 { error }`.
- `GET /orders` → all orders, newest first.
- Put the order logic in a new `src/orders.js` (e.g. an `OrderBook` class) rather than in the route handler. Add tests.
plan:
Add OrderBook class in src/orders.js to manage orders with all-or-nothing stock checks; wire new /orders routes in src/server.js; add tests in test/orders.test.js.
1. Add new OrderBook implementation
2. Wire routes in server to use OrderBook
3. Add tests for orders endpoints
requirements: POST /orders accepts { items: [{ id, quantity }], discountCode? } and validates input like quote (items required and non-empty, known book ids, positive integer quantities, valid discount code) and returns 400 { error } on validation failure
POST /orders checks stock for all items first; if any item has insufficient stock respond 409 { error, item: <bookId> } and make no inventory changes
POST /orders when stock is sufficient decrements stock for every item and creates an order { id, items, totalCents, createdAt } and responds 201 with the order
Order ids are sequential per app instance: ord_1, ord_2, ...
GET /orders/:id returns the order or 404 { error }
GET /orders returns all orders, newest first
Order logic must live in new src/orders.js as an OrderBook (class)
Add tests covering creating an order, stock conflict behavior, GET /orders and GET /orders/:id
summary:
Added OrderBook class in src/orders.js implementing all-or-nothing stock checks, validation, sequential order ids (ord_1...), ISO createdAt, listing newest-first. Wired routes in src/server.js: POST /orders, GET /orders, GET /orders/:id and mapped errors to 400/409/404. Added tests in test/orders.test.js covering creation, conflict no-stock-change, and listing/fetching orders. Verified with npm test: all new tests pass. Note: one pre-existing unrelated failing test remains (math.divide divide by zero expected RangeError) which was failing before changes.

Requirements:
1. R1: POST /orders validation -> satisfied by OrderBook.validatePayload in src/orders.js and server mapping to 400 (src/orders.js, src/server.js)
2. R2: all-or-nothing stock checks -> satisfied by pre-check loop in OrderBook.create before any inventory.remove (src/orders.js)
3. R3: decrement stock and create order object -> satisfied by OrderBook.create performing inventory.remove, building order with id, items, totalCents, createdAt and returning 201 from server (src/orders.js, src/server.js)
4. R4: sequential ids ord_1... -> satisfied via this.counter in OrderBook (src/orders.js)
5. R5: createdAt ISO timestamp -> new Date().toISOString() used in OrderBook.create (src/orders.js)
6. R6: GET /orders/:id -> implemented in src/server.js using orders.find (src/server.js, src/orders.js)
7. R7: GET /orders newest first -> OrderBook.list returns reverse of stored orders (src/orders.js)
8. R8: Order logic in src/orders.js OrderBook class -> implemented (src/orders.js)
9. R9: Tests added covering creating an order, stock conflict, GET /orders and GET /orders/:id -> test/orders.test.js added and passing (test/orders.test.js)

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..eb8e860
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/orders.js
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import { Cart, DISCOUNT_CODES } from './cart.js'
+
+export class ValidationError extends Error {}
+export class ConflictError extends Error {
+  constructor(item) {
+    super('Insufficient stock')
+    this.item = item
+  }
+}
+
+/** Manage orders with all-or-nothing stock checks. */
+export class OrderBook {
+  /** @param {import('./inventory.js').Inventory} inventory */
+  constructor(inventory) {
+    this.inventory = inventory
+    this.orders = []
+    this.counter = 0
+  }
+
+  list() {
+    // newest first
+    return [...this.orders].reverse()
+  }
+
+  find(id) {
+    return this.orders.find((o) => o.id === id) ?? null
+  }
+
+  validatePayload(body) {
+    if (!body || !Array.isArray(body.items) || body.items.length === 0) throw new ValidationError('items required')
+    for (const it of body.items) {
+      if (!it || typeof it.id !== 'string') throw new ValidationError('invalid item id')
+      if (!Number.isInteger(it.quantity) || it.quantity <= 0) throw new ValidationError('invalid quantity')
+      const book = this.inventory.find(it.id)
+      if (!book) throw new ValidationError(`Unknown book: ${it.id}`)
+    }
+    if (body.discountCode && !DISCOUNT_CODES[body.discountCode]) throw new ValidationError('Invalid discount code')
+  }
+
+  create(body) {
+    this.validatePayload(body)
+
+    // check stock for all items first
+    for (const it of body.items) {
+      const book = this.inventory.find(it.id)
+      if (book.stock < it.quantity) throw new ConflictError(it.id)
+    }
+
+    // compute total using a Cart (doesn't mutate inventory)
+    const cart = new Cart(this.inventory)
+    for (const it of body.items) cart.addItem(it.id, it.quantity)
+    if (body.discountCode) cart.applyDiscount(body.discountCode)
+    const total = cart.total()
+
+    // decrement stock for every item
+    for (const it of body.items) this.inventory.remove(it.id, it.quantity)
+
+    this.counter += 1
+    const id = `ord_${this.counter}`
+    const order = { id, items: Object.fromEntries(body.items.map((i) => [i.id, i.quantity])), totalCents: total, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }
+    this.orders.push(order)
+    return order
+  }
+}
+
+export default OrderBook
+

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/orders.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { createApp } from '../src/server.js'
+import { Inventory } from '../src/inventory.js'
+
+const app = () => createApp(new Inventory([
+  { id: 'x1', title: 'A', author: 'A', priceCents: 1000, stock: 2 },
+  { id: 'x2', title: 'B', author: 'B', priceCents: 500, stock: 1 },
+]))
+
+test('POST /orders creates an order and reduces stock', async () => {
+  const a = app()
+  const res = await a({ method: 'POST', url: '/orders', body: { items: [{ id: 'x1', quantity: 2 }] } })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 201)
+  assert.equal(res.body.id, 'ord_1')
+  assert.equal(res.body.totalCents > 0, true)
+  // stock reduced
+  const books = await a({ method: 'GET', url: '/books' })
+  const b = books.body.find((b) => b.id === 'x1')
+  assert.equal(b.stock, 0)
+})
+
+test('POST /orders conflicts if any item lacks stock and does not change stock', async () => {
+  const a = app()
+  // attempt order that exceeds stock for x2
+  const res = await a({ method: 'POST', url: '/orders', body: { items: [{ id: 'x2', quantity: 2 }, { id: 'x1', quantity: 1 }] } })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 409)
+  assert.equal(res.body.item, 'x2')
+  // ensure no stock changed
+  const books = await a({ method: 'GET', url: '/books' })
+  const bx2 = books.body.find((b) => b.id === 'x2')
+  const bx1 = books.body.find((b) => b.id === 'x1')
+  assert.equal(bx2.stock, 1)
+  assert.equal(bx1.stock, 2)
+})
+
+test('GET /orders and GET /orders/:id', async () => {
+  const a = app()
+  await a({ method: 'POST', url: '/orders', body: { items: [{ id: 'x1', quantity: 1 }] } })
+  await a({ method: 'POST', url: '/orders', body: { items: [{ id: 'x1', quantity: 1 }] } })
+  const all = await a({ method: 'GET', url: '/orders' })
+  assert.equal(all.status, 200)
+  assert.equal(all.body.length, 2)
+  // newest first
+  const first = all.body[0]
+  const byId = await a({ method: 'GET', url: `/orders/${first.id}` })
+  assert.equal(byId.status, 200)
+  assert.equal(byId.body.id, first.id)
+})
